ABOUT ME

Actor. Storyteller. Aspiring Director.

I believe great performances are born from honesty, observation and continuous learning. Every role is an opportunity to understand a new life and bring it to the screen with authenticity.

Alongside acting, I am actively developing myself as a filmmaker, learning direction, screenplay, visual storytelling and cinematic language to create meaningful stories.
